title: 总结-评判-精炼：多模态内容审核的解耦理解与策略学习
summary: 提出SJR双模型架构，将多模态内容理解与政策分类解耦：多模态内容模型生成结构化文本摘要，纯文本政策模型据此分类。通过GRPO迭代协同训练和文本空间增强实现少样本政策启动，在误导性广告检测中相对F1提升23.6%，且零真实违规样本训练也能接近全量数据效果。
summary_en: Proposes Summarize-Judge-Refine (SJR), a two-model architecture decoupling multimodal content understanding from policy classification: a multimodal Content Model generates structured text summaries, and a text-only Policy Model classifies them. An iterative GRPO co-training loop and text-space augmentation enable few-shot policy bootstrap. On misleading advertisement detection, SJR achieves +23.6% relative F1 over zero-shot CoT, and a variant trained on zero real violating examples matches the full-data model within 0.2%.
